description: Local config of is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada. Keep it outside the skill; point TRIAGE_CONFIG at it. No value here ships with the skill.

costs.file: <path to a JSON cost file: { "scenarios": { "<name>": { "entrySlippage": 0, "exitSlippage": 0, "stopLossSlippage": 0, "openingFees": 0, "closingFees": 0 } } } in Option Omega units>

runRoot: <folder for one run folder per triage>
notes: costs: give either file or command (argv array that prints the same JSON, e.g. a converter from your own cost file). cost2x: a named scenario, or null for base slippage x 2. thresholds: path of your copy of thresholds.json, or null for the default. protocolHook: argv array called with the run folder as last argument, or null.
